title: Certificates of Deposit: The Grace Period After Maturity and What the Owner May Do in It
content:
Once any of the bank's Certificates of Deposit reaches its maturity date it enters a short grace period. During that window the owner can reshape the certificate without any early withdrawal penalty. This page sets the length of the window at Piedmont Crescent Bank and the actions it opens.

## Length of the window

Grace actions are permitted only while no more than the tier's grace days have gone by since the maturity date. The anchor is the maturity date on the certificate record. Day 1 is the calendar day that follows the maturity date; grace actions remain open up to and including the date that is the grace days after the maturity date, and are closed from the following day.

## Actions open during grace, free of penalty

- **Withdrawing part of the balance**, on a tier that permits a partial withdrawal in grace.
- **Withdrawing the whole balance**, which closes the certificate.
- **Renewing into a different tier**, on a tier that permits a change of term in grace.
- **Adding money.** The earlier clause that admitted grace add-ons on a tier allowing them, with every single deposit at least the tier's grace minimum and the period's total within the tier's figure, is **no longer in force**; money added in grace is now accepted under the current grace add-on basis. The tier figures below remain the tier's figures.

A withdrawal made during grace is recorded as a grace-period withdrawal and carries no penalty.

## Tier figures

| Tier | Grace days after maturity | Grace add-ons allowed | Smallest single grace add-on | Most added in one grace period | Partial withdrawal in grace |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 6-Month Certificate | 10 | Yes | USD 100.00 | USD 250000.00 | Yes |
| 11-Month No-Penalty Certificate | 10 | Yes | USD 100.00 | USD 250000.00 | Yes |
| 12-Month Certificate | 10 | Yes | USD 100.00 | USD 250000.00 | Yes |
| 18-Month Bump-Up Certificate | 10 | Yes | USD 100.00 | USD 250000.00 | Yes |
| 36-Month Certificate | 10 | Yes | USD 100.00 | USD 250000.00 | Yes |
| 60-Month Certificate | 10 | Yes | USD 100.00 | USD 250000.00 | Yes |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical maturity date 15 June)

| Date of the action | Day count | Inside the grace window? |
|---|---|---|
| 16 June | day 1 | Yes |
| 25 June | day 10 | Yes, the last day |
| 26 June | day 11 | No |

## Points of judgement

**Is a withdrawal on the tenth day after maturity penalty-free?** Yes. That day is still inside the window, and a grace-period withdrawal carries no penalty.

**Is the maturity date itself a grace day?** The count starts the day after the maturity date, so the first grace day is the day after maturity.
